title: Luke 14:1, 7-11
subtitle: Saturday of the 30th Week in Ordinary Time · Phil 1:18b-26; Lk 14:1, 7-11
text: At a Sabbath dinner, Jesus watched the guests choose the places of honor and told them to take the lowest place instead, so the host could invite them higher. Humility is not thinking less of yourself; it is letting God, not the room, decide where you sit. “Everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.”
imageAlt: Sepia etching of a banquet hall: a host in a turban gestures toward a guest seated low on the floor near the doorway while other guests sit at a long table.
